answer: In m3, BMW Group reported: total water consumption 1,861,542 in 2025 versus 2,093,253 in 2024 (−11.1%); consumption in water-risk areas 1,249,501 versus 1,411,145 (−11.5%); recycled and reused 4,905,853 versus 4,779,094 (+2.7%); stored water 455,054 versus 458,025 (−0.6%); changes in storage 354,528 versus 336,220 (+5.4%); and total withdrawals 5,699,543 versus 5,848,597 (−2.5%). The consumption methodology was aligned with standard practice and data infrastructure improved. Prior-year adjustments were −3,720,490 m3 for total consumption, −1,668,125 m3 for water-risk-area consumption, +665 m3 for recycled/reused, and +2,500 m3 each for stored water and storage change. The 2024 withdrawal comparator was determined for the first time.

normalized_value.qualification: retrospective methodology/data-infrastructure adjustments; first-time 2024 comparative for water withdrawals

evidence.quote: A comparative value was determined for the previous year as part of the first-time reporting on water withdrawal.
